review_description: I couldn’t be happier with Mark and his teams installation of my solar battery system. From the initial consultation to the final setup, the entire process was seamless, professional, and well-executed.The team was incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to explain every step, helping me understand how the battery integrates with my existing solar system and how it will benefit my energy usage long-term. They provided clear, upfront pricing with no hidden costs, and the installation was completed right on schedule.The installers were punctual, courteous, and left the site spotless. They ensured everything was working perfectly before they left and walked me through the monitoring system so I can easily track my energy storage and usage.Since the installation, I’ve noticed a significant reduction in my reliance on the grid, especially during peak hours and outages. It feels great knowing I’m using more of my own clean energy and increasing my energy independence.If you're considering a solar battery, I highly recommend MLG solar. Their service, expertise, and commitment to quality are top-notch. This investment has not only improved my energy efficiency but also given me peace of mind.

Mark asked the right questions and got the pictures/information he requested in preparation for the installation, which was  very neat and tidy, they were Polite at all times and explained what they were doing and why. He setup the App on my phone and got it all working, then demonstrated the features of the App.They did a great job, Thanks Guys'Martin Phillips

His quote was extremely competitive and provided the best value for my needs.On the day he walked me through the whole process and did an excellent job installing the system. He and his counterpart tidied everything up and the install looks great!Would highly recommend Mark and MLG.

MKG is an excellent business. They consistently delivered quality - I've had them install a solar system and got them back 3 months later to install a battery. The installations have been smooth, with staff arriving on time and with a very polite and cheerful team.  The biggest stand out to me is that the owners really wanted me to have the best experience - decisions re solar systems can be tricky and mine was. My property needed a complete rewire and new switchboard. The owners were accessible and really worked with me to get the best system for my property. They managed the whole process including grid connection and it was very seamless. Would highly recommend MKG
